description: This file is a shell script for testing various scenarios of repository corruption and error handling in Git. It includes functions to manipulate Git objects, sets up test repositories with specific corruptions or missing objects, and runs Git commands to verify that corruption is detected appropriately.

methods.name: obj_to_file
methods.description: Converts a Git object notation into a file path within the Git objects directory.

methods.name: corrupt_byte
methods.description: Modifies a specific byte in a Git object's file to corrupt it.
